subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: Is the current skipped/internal Mantis manifest enough proof for this reason-aware wake-false fallback, or should visible/live gateway proof remain required before merge?
rationale: The patch itself is source-supported, but the external PR proof gate is not satisfied by a skipped baseline/candidate artifact unless maintainers intentionally accept internal-path proof for this failure mode.

options.title: Require Real Channel Proof
options.body: Keep the PR paused until redacted Telegram/gateway logs, terminal output, or a linked artifact shows the allowlisted wake-false path delivering exactly once after the patch.

options.title: Accept Internal Scheduler Proof
options.body: Allow maintainers to accept the mocked scheduler matrix plus Mantis fixed=true manifest as sufficient for this internal recovery path while owning the remaining live-delivery uncertainty.

options.title: Use The Proof Stack First
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97448 or equivalent stacked proof to produce the baseline/candidate evidence before deciding this implementation PR.

recommendation.title: Require Real Channel Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR paused until redacted Telegram/gateway logs, terminal output, or a linked artifact shows the allowlisted wake-false path delivering exactly once after the patch.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the original shared media completion recovery behavior and is the strongest history signal for the delivery-boundary decision.
